name: fleet-over-land
description: TikTok video: The fleet that sailed over land (1453), built with Remotion

scripts.master: ffmpeg -y -i out/fleet-over-land.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k fleet-over-land.mp4
scripts.master:tr: ffmpeg -y -i out/fleet-over-land-tr.mp4 -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 21 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k fleet-over-land-tr.mp4
